text:
Come, beautiful cat, to my loving breast;

Hold back the claws of your paw,

And let me sink into your lovely eyes,

A mixture of agate and metal.


While my fingers softly comb

Your head and your elastic back,

While my hand grows drunk with pleasure

Touching your electric body,


I think I see my lady. Her gaze,

Like yours, amiable beast,

Deep and cold, wounds like a dart,


And, from feet to head,

A subtle air, a dangerous scent,

Sail around her tawny body.

translation.title: The Cat
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the sensual comparison between the cat's gaze/body and the beloved's dangerous presence.
